Description: Enterprise governance: scoped HOTL/HITL, private approval callbacks, durable report delivery and operational alarms.

RuntimeCodeVersion.Description: S3 object version for the reviewed immutable runtime ZIP

RuntimeCodeSha256.Description: Base64 SHA-256 checked again when publishing each Lambda version

InstallationId.Description: Exact owning foundation installation ID; installer verifies its output

IngressAlarmNames.Description: Installer computes the four exact owned log-ingress alarm names for each installed resource region

RuntimeConfigRevision.Description: Installer hashes effective environment configuration; publishes a new retained version on configuration changes

SlackSecretKeyArn.Description: Optional customer KMS key of the configured Slack secret

NaclResponseEnabled.Description: Optional IAM capability; each service still requires explicit NACL policy and reserved slots
